key_findings: Transcriptomics of rat CCI muscle identified FOS, RAC2 and TYROBP as potential biomarkers of Fu's subcutaneous needling in neuropathic pain.
FSN lowered FOS and raised RAC2 and TYROBP expression relative to untreated CCI model, validated by RT-qPCR.
